Area.evidence_source: In other cases alcohol seemed to have contributed to the decedents' being socially irresponsible. Their way of living centered around alcohol, yet they did not have the income to sustain their drinking. Thus, they ended up acting irresponsibly as exemplified below: But the issue of the money might have been a heavy burden on him because when he died as we searched in the house and his bags we never found a single coin and remember he would drink every day and did not have any income, so it means he was drinking that money [the deceased had been entrusted with money by a clan committee]. For fear of the committee and the son, even the son had cautioned him about being a cashier of that money but he went ahead and did it stealthily without his knowledge.
